title: Salmon puttanesca with new potatoes
summary: Salmon puttanesca with new potatoes is a italian dinner built around salmon fillets and new potatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Salmon puttanesca with new potatoes into even pieces and toss new potatoes with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of new potatoes while you season salmon fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle salmon fillets and cherry tomatoes among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Salmon puttanesca with new potatoes before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Salmon puttanesca with new potatoes into warm bowls with the juices.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
